name: VEX V5 Tank Drive
description: Starter VEX V5 competition drivebase: 4 x 11 W Smart Motors with blue (600 rpm) cartridges geared 36:60 to 4 in omni wheels (360 rpm at the wheel), aluminum C-channel frame inside the 18 in V5RC starting size. Motor numbers are VEX's published ratings; mass and size are typical values for a bare drivebase, not measurements of one robot.
